title: Divine Nature
english: It is said that he hungered and thirsted and labored and died due to the economy, but he lives full of power from God, and not having received the ability to do all things from another, but having it inherently from himself, for he is God by nature.
translator_notes: The Greek text appears to be a fragment, ending mid-sentence.
No obvious Bible references were found in this passage.
baehrens: PG 74; Fragmenta in 2 Cor u05 rem mid

title: Suffering and Resurrection
english: Having suffered in the flesh for us, if they stumble over the cross, they should marvel at the resurrection; and even if it is said that he lives by the power of God, you will still understand the power of God as the Son.
translator_notes: The Greek text appears to be a fragment, cut off at the beginning and possibly at the end, as indicated by the presence of a standalone number '17' which seems to be an editor's note or a page number, not part of the text itself.
